title: Morocco Economic Forecasting Models
subtitle: ML models for Morocco GDP growth prediction and economic regime classification
description:
## Morocco Economic Forecasting Models

A collection of machine learning models for analyzing and forecasting Morocco-s macroeconomic indicators.

### Models
1. Random Forest (R2=0.87) - GDP growth prediction
2. Lasso (R2=0.82) - GDP growth with feature selection
3. ARIMA - Time series forecasting
4. Deep Learning (R2=0.79) - MLP neural network

### Data Sources
World Bank, IMF, UNDP, OWID, Casablanca Stock Exchange

### Use Cases
Economic policy analysis, growth scenario modeling, economic regime identification, investment decision support
